thread:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — need final SEO ops for the launch posts + benchmark narrative gated PDF. Top priorities: redirects, JSON-LD schema, internal linking anchors to gated form, canonical/UTM normalization, and analytics events. Who can take which?
Samir Patel: I can own redirects. Plan: temporary 302 first-week for traffic parity, then 301. Draft nginx rules below. Will push to staging and run smoke test.
Samir Patel: ```# example redirect rule
location ~ ^/blog/(.*)-old$ {
  return 302 https://redwood.com/launch/$1$is_args$args;
}
# fallback: preserve query strings except utm_* (handled later)
```
Olivia Park: I’ll handle schema. We need Article for launch posts + Dataset/Report schema for the gated PDF. Quick JSON-LD stub: ```{"@context": "https://schema.org","@type": "Article","headline": "Launch playbook: ...","author": {"@type":"Person","name":"Maya Chen"},"mainEntityOfPage": {"@type":"WebPage","@id":"https://redwood.com/launch"}}``` Will add `isAccessibleForFree`/`hasPart` for the gated asset.
Priya Nair: Internal links: I’ll update 4 priority posts to add a contextual CTA to the gated report (anchor text: “Redwood launch benchmark”). Add top-of-post summary link + in-body CTA after 2nd H2. Also add canonical rel to hub pages. Avoid adding rel=canonical on paginated lists.
Jeff Ramos: Analytics/UTM: We'll fire `launch_cta_click` event on the CTA button and push `report_view` on gated form load. For canonical/UTM: strip `utm_source`/`utm_medium` from canonical but keep `utm_campaign` for campaign attribution in analytics only. Use server-side normalization to avoid duplicate canonicals.
Maya Chen: Decision note: do 302 for the first 7 days for monitoring, then flip to 301. @Samir can you add a small header that sets `Cache-Control: max-age=600` for the redirects during the test window? :eyes:
Samir Patel: ack — will include header in staging config and add smoke test (curl + check 302/301 and cache header).
deploy-bot: Staging deploy: redirects-config branch deployed to staging at 1712350200 — all redirect smoke tests passed :white_check_mark: (details in CI).
Maya Chen: Olivia — once JSON-LD is in staging, run Rich Results test for one sample page and post screenshot. Priya — add the anchor updates in the same PR if possible to minimize deploys.
Olivia Park: Will run Google Rich Results and Screaming Frog crawl. Posting results here after run.
Priya Nair: I'll open PR with copy and links in next 2 hours, tag @Maya for content QA.
Jeff Ramos: I'll add the analytics GTM change to the same release branch; will include dataLayer snippet in PR description.
Maya Chen: Thanks all. If no blockers, we’ll flip to 301 after 7 days and confirm GA events look good. Scheduling 15m follow-up right after PR merge to validate metrics. :calendar:
